# ANALYSIS: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND_HIGH_VIX_EVAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** evaluation  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND veto, which blocks PUT entries in a confirmed 5m uptrend and CALL entries in a confirmed 5m downtrend, may provide additional edge in high-VIX regimes (VIX>20) by avoiding wrong-way trades during volatile trending markets, without harming the 5/04 PUT winner which occurs in a ranging market (thus no veto).

## Mechanism

No mechanism change; we are evaluating the existing veto under a regime filter. The veto uses `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` (5m-sameday) to block P-in-uptrend / C-in-downtrend; range/unknown=no-veto. For this analysis, we slice real-fills OPRA A/B data by VIX>20 and compare engine performance with vs. without the veto.
